reason: I already take Toplux and reorder it when it runs out, and it costs less and lasts longer. $29.99 for 30 days is more than I pay now, so I have no reason to switch.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I don't see what I get extra for the difference.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what I pay now, around $20 for 30 days, and a reason the lab-tested batch report is worth switching for.
